comparison.objective: Separate ceramic media from metal washers, versus measure powdered formula into a bottle.
comparison.physical_skill: Orientation-dependent sifting and bridge clearing versus scooping, leveling and dosing powder.
comparison.success_condition: At least 98% media passes while all washers remain, versus two leveled scoops within a dose-mass window and limited spill.
comparison.reason: Both manipulate granular material, but selective aperture separation and exact volumetric dosing test different abilities.
